name: How much does it cost to remodel a rental property bathroom?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to remodel a rental property bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a rental property bathroom remodel varies widely based on scope and material choices. A minor refresh, including new paint, fixtures, and cosmetic updates, might range from $3,000 to $7,000. A mid-range remodel involving new flooring, vanity, and shower could be $8,000 to $15,000. For a complete gut renovation with premium materials and layout changes, costs can exceed $20,000. These figures are estimates, and a detailed quote from a contractor is essential.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathroom remodel costs for rental properties vary from $3,000 for minor updates to over $20,000 for full renovations, depending on scope and materials.
